svg.text: Hand the rush hours to your station
Drag the blue service edges and yellow peak edges to test what your station can take.
Drag the time edges to stretch the peaks.
Use the sliders below for crowd strength.
Pick a weekday, weekend or holiday,
Every entrance sets its own flow.
After adding demand, run the station and see where queues grow first.
